title: NASA director wrote psychic spy manual for CIA
summary: Jesse Michels tells of NASA director wrote psychic spy manual for CIA, about unspecified at NASA / CIA, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think like there's a director at um NASA as >> his name is Steven Hubard I believe and he wrote a psychic spy manual for the CIA.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he thinks there is a director at NASA, the US space agency, named Steven Hubbard, as he believes, who wrote a psychic spy manual for the CIA, America's foreign spy agency. If true, it would tie the space agency to government work on using the mind to gather secrets.
